think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and data type. 2) Check the documented valid range and whether any sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) change the knob’s meaning from “limit/amount” to “disable/enable/auto”. 3) If a sentinel value triggers a qualitatively different behavior (e.g., disables enforcement), classify it as a special knob. 4) Record the sentinel value(s) as special_value.
